column1: ## Wait 20 working days from when you sent the IHT400 to HMRC The letter or email from HMRC will be sent out up to 20 working days after you submit the IHT400. ### If you have not received a letter or email from HMRC after 20 days Contact HMRC on this number: Telephone: 0300 123 1072 Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm (except public holidays) Find out about call charges.
